prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary photograph of one unmistakably adult female orbital botanist inside a transparent rotating greenhouse module during an orbital greenhouse pollination emergency. Use the supplied appearance reference to inspire her refined oval face, clear light complexion, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, straight soft brows, slim nose, and softly full lips; her face is unobscured. Give her a structural hime cut: a long rear hair mass continues below the side panels; paired blunt cheek-to-jaw side panels frame the face; a visible disconnected length step separates panels from rear hair; both side panels remain readable beside one face; ordinary feathered face-framing layers do not substitute. Use an eye-level vertical medium portrait wide enough to include the crown, complete hair ends, both hands, brush, and blossoms. A failed pollinator drone hangs above flowering vanilla vines as she manually transfers bright golden pollen between open blossoms with a charged botanical brush. Amber alarm glyphs pulse, loose pollen drifts, and Earth arcs beyond the glass. Cool Earthlight and amber alarm illumination share believable direction across her face, hair, the greenhouse glass, and foliage.
negative_en: fake-looking background, illustration look, cartoon style, warped product geometry, excessive HDR, low resolution, inaccurate reflections, over-processed retouching, 3D render look
